summary: Located in the heart of the town centre, this larger-than-average Victorian terrace occupies a prime position with an array of shops, bars, restaurants, and cafés right on your doorstep.
description:
The property is ideally situated close to local amenities, including schools and supermarkets, and is within walking distance of Darlington main train station. Just a short stroll away is the historic South Park, a vibrant green space offering something for everyone-from scenic walks and beautiful parkland to sporting facilities, fitness opportunities, community events, and family-friendly activities. This spacious home is immaculately presented throughout, combining the charm and character of a traditional Victorian terrace with a contemporary, stylish feel. The current owner has cleverly adapted the property so that each level offers self-contained living space, providing flexibility for multi-generational living, rental opportunities, or professional use. Despite these adaptations, it could easily be returned to its former layout as a large, three-bedroom family home. The result is a property that is both versatile and full of character, with features that must be seen to be fully appreciated. The lower ground floor provides a welcoming entrance hall leading to a lounge with double doors opening onto a bedroom, a kitchen, a further bedroom, and a bathroom. A rear hall provides access to the outside area, which is perfect for off-road parking or pleasant outdoor seating, offering a private and functional outdoor space. The ground floor has been thoughtfully arranged to include an open-plan lounge and dining kitchen, a spacious double bedroom, and a contemporary bathroom, creating a versatile and comfortable living space. The first floor continues the theme of adaptable living, with a further open-plan living and dining room complete with kitchen, a bedroom, and a bathroom, providing independent living space with style and comfort. Offered to the market with no onward chain, this property represents a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial, versatile home in a sought-after location. Its combination of space, character, and flexibility makes it a must-see for families, investors, or those looking for a property with potential for multi-level living. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this exceptional home has to offer.

LOWER GROUND FLOOR

ENTRANCE HALL The entrance hall is accessed via a stylish composite and glass door, immediately creating a welcoming first impression. The hall is finished with elegant wood effect flooring and inset ceiling spotlights, which add a contemporary touch and brighten the space. An oak and glass door provides access to the kitchen, which in turn leads seamlessly into the lounge, creating a natural flow through the basement living areas.

LOUNGE Accessed via an oak and glass door, the lounge is an impressively spacious room that perfectly blends contemporary style with period character. High ceilings enhance the sense of space, while elegant herringbone wood effect flooring adds warmth and sophistication underfoot. A striking feature fireplace, with a marble inset, tiled detailing, and hearth, serves as a stylish focal point. Natural light floods the room through a UPVC framed, double-glazed bay-style window, complete with a fitted feature window seat beneath. Three radiators provide warmth throughout, and there is ample space for a dining table and chairs. Double doors open into a double bedroom, further enhancing the versatility and flow of the basement living space.

KITCHEN/BREAKFAST ROOM The basement kitchen is fitted with a high-quality range of base and wall units, complemented by a built-in larder cupboard and an integrated wine rack, providing excellent storage and a touch of elegance. Work surfaces are finished to a high standard, with an inset sink and drainer complete with mixer tap, and tiling to splashback and work areas for a practical yet stylish finish. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob, and a chimney-style extractor hood. A built-in corner seating area with space for a breakfast table creates a charming breakfast nook, perfect for casual dining. The room is finished with wood effect flooring and benefits from an oak and glass door leading to the rear hall, as well as an oak door providing access to the inner hall, maintaining a seamless flow throughout the basement level.

INNER HALL The inner hall features elegant wood effect flooring and contemporary oak doors that provide access to both basement bedrooms. The clean, modern design enhances the sense of space while maintaining a seamless flow between the rooms.

BEDROOM ONE A spacious double bedroom, featuring elegant herringbone wood effect flooring and a radiator, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Double doors provide direct access into the lounge, allowing for a flexible and connected living space.

BEDROOM TWO

Another generously proportioned double bedroom, featuring wood flooring, a radiator, and a UPVC framed double-glazed window that fills the room with natural light. Inset ceiling spotlights add a contemporary touch, and there is ample space to accommodate a desk, dressing table, or additional storage, making this a versatile and comfortable living area.

REAR HALL The rear hall features attractive feature tiled flooring and a radiator, combining style with practicality. A composite door with glass inserts allows natural light to filter through, while an oak door provides access to the basement bathroom, creating a seamless connection between the living and utility areas.

BATHROOM The basement bathroom features a modern white suite, comprising a corner shower cubicle with a mains inset rain head shower and an additional handheld shower attachment, a wash hand basin, and a WC. The room is finished with tiling to splashback and vanity areas, combining practicality with style, and a UPVC framed double-glazed window provides natural light and ventilation.

GROUND FLOOR

ENTRANCE HALL Accessed via the front door, the communal entrance hall makes a welcoming statement with a grand and airy feel, setting the tone for the rest of the property. A further door, featuring a stunning stained glass insert and surround, leads into the spacious hallway, creating a sense of elegance and character from the moment you enter.

HALLWAY The entrance hallway exudes elegance and character, featuring high ceilings, decorative ceiling coving, and ornate period features that create a striking first impression. Inset ceiling spotlights add a contemporary touch, while there is space to accommodate storage units or a sideboard. Practicality is also considered, with plumbing in place for an automatic washing machine. A wide staircase leads gracefully to the first floor, and a door opens into an inner space that flows seamlessly into the open-plan lounge, dining, and kitchen area, creating a sense of spacious, interconnected living.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / DINING /KITCHEN This expansive open-plan living space is filled with natural light and offers a versatile and contemporary living environment. The lounge area features a large UPVC framed double-glazed bay-style window with decorative panelling beneath, allowing light to flood the room, while high ceilings with elegant coving enhance the sense of space and grandeur. The dining area provides ample room for a large table and chairs, making it perfect for entertaining. The modern kitchen is fitted with a stylish range of high-gloss base and wall units, complemented by work surfaces with contrasting splashbacks. Integrated appliances include an oven, hob, stainless steel chimney-style extractor, and fridge, while an inset sink with drainer and mixer tap completes the practical yet elegant design. Feature herringbone oak flooring flows throughout the space, and inset ceiling spotlights add a contemporary touch. An oak door leads through to the inner hallway, maintaining a seamless flow between the different areas of the home.

INNER HALLWAY The inner hall is a bright and practical space, featuring a radiator and inset ceiling spotlights that enhance the contemporary feel. Doors provide access to the ground floor bedroom and bathroom, while a composite door leads out to an external spiral staircase, offering convenient access to the upper levels and the garden.

BEDROOM A well-proportioned bedroom, featuring a UPVC framed double-glazed window that fills the room with natural light, and a radiator providing warmth. The room also benefits from cleverly designed built-in storage within the alcove, combining practicality with a clean, uncluttered aesthetic.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite, comprising a corner shower cubicle with an inset mains rain head shower and an additional handheld shower attachment, a wash hand basin, and a WC. The room is finished with tiling to splashback and vanity areas and a fully tiled floor, creating a sleek and practical space. A wall-mounted gas central heating combination boiler and a radiator provide efficient warmth, while two UPVC framed double-glazed windows allow for natural light and ventilation.

FIRST FLOOR

FIRST FLOOR LANDING Accessed via the grand staircase, the first-floor landing exudes elegance with high ceilings and decorative coving, creating a bright and airy feel. The inner hallway provides a practical connection to all first-floor rooms and includes a composite door giving access to the external spiral staircase, allowing convenient movement between floors and outdoor areas. There is also loft access with potential to convert.

OPEN PLAN LOUNGE / KITCHEN / DINING AREA This impressive first-floor open-plan living space is exceptionally spacious, with high ceilings that enhance the sense of grandeur. Accessed via floor-to-ceiling see-through feature glass doors, the area exudes a contemporary and stylish feel. The lounge space features solid wood flooring and a striking feature fireplace with inset and hearth, creating a focal point for relaxation. Three UPVC framed double-glazed windows flood the space with natural light, while a dedicated dining area provides ample room for a large table and chairs, perfect for entertaining. The modern fitted kitchen is complemented by an exposed brick feature wall, adding character and warmth. It includes a fitted range of contemporary base units with wood work surfaces, an inset sink and drainer with mixer tap, and integrated appliances including an oven, hob, dishwasher, and fridge-freezer. A step up from the kitchen area leads seamlessly into the open-plan bedroom space, creating a versatile and stylish living environment.

BEDROOM AREA The spacious open-plan bedroom area is finished with elegant wood flooring and a UPVC framed double-glazed window, allowing natural light to fill the space. Inset ceiling spotlights add a contemporary touch, while fitted wardrobes provide practical storage. There is ample room to accommodate bedroom furniture, a dressing table, or a desk, making the area versatile for use as a comfortable sleeping space or a home office.

FAMILY BATHROOM The first-floor bathroom features a contemporary white suite, comprising a panelled bath with a mains rain head shower and an additional handheld attachment, a wash hand basin set into a vanity unit, and a WC. Part-tiled walls to splashback and vanity areas combine style with practicality, while inset ceiling spotlights enhance the modern feel. A UPVC framed double-glazed window provides natural light and ventilation, and a radiator ensures warmth. The room also houses a wall-mounted combination gas central heating boiler, completing this functional yet stylish family bathroom.

EXTERNALLY The property makes a striking first impression, approached via wide, elegant steps leading up to a grand front door. The front garden is thoughtfully landscaped with a variety of mature shrubs, offering a welcoming and tranquil outlook while enhancing privacy for the basement lounge below. Access to the basement is secured via a wrought iron gate, with steps leading down to a private porch area, providing both security and a sense of seclusion. To the rear, the property boasts a generously proportioned garden, combining practical and attractive features. A large gravelled area provides low-maintenance outdoor space, while a hardstanding section offers ample off-road parking. The garden is versatile, perfect for outdoor entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying family time. Adding to the property's unique charm and functionality, an external spiral staircase links the rear garden with the ground and first-floor levels, allowing convenient and independent access to each living area. This thoughtfully designed outdoor space complements the home's flexible, multi-level layout while enhancing privacy, practicality, and curb appeal.
